items.title: Intel (INTC) Hit With Shareholder Lawsuit Over PC Slowdown And AI Claims
items.summary: Intel (NasdaqGS: INTC) has been hit with a shareholder class action lawsuit alleging misleading disclosures around its PC market slowdown and inventory buildup. The complaint claims Intel executives overstated benefits tied to AI infrastructure and data center activity while downplaying offsetting headwinds in its core PC business. Shareholders argue that Intel failed to fully explain how excess inventory and weaker PC demand could affect results and operational risks. This new class action...
